evidence_gaps: No fresh-within-two-hours sanitised runtime forensics; evidence_status is MISSING_RUNTIME_FORENSICS.
No reconciled per-strategy, per-chain sequence of decisions, broadcasts, final receipts, wallet deltas, and position closures.
No complete user-net ledger including DEX/platform fees, slippage, price impact, EVM gas, Solana base/priority/tip fees, profit share, failed-attempt spend, and refundable versus unrecovered rent.
No monetary attribution separating STRATEGY/MARKET losses from EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE failures.
No point-in-time common-unit valuation, notional, capital-at-risk, or capital-time data for cross-chain money weighting.
No out-of-sample performance by chain, strategy, asset/liquidity band, volatility regime, congestion regime, and trade-size band.
No Solana contemporaneous executable entry-and-exit quote adapter with sellability, route impact, priority-fee, latency, and failure reserves.

proposals.downside_risk: Slower promotion and fewer trades; this is preferable to deploying an unproven edge.

evidence.detail: evidence_status is MISSING_RUNTIME_FORENSICS and the note prohibits profitability or canary-readiness claims.
Accepted shadow_only review decisions can enter a real-money EVM CANARY lane; progression then requires only 3 and 8 recorded trades.
The module correctly states that quote simulations are not promotion evidence and require realised out-of-sample validation.

proposals.expected_effect: Prevents stale or architecture-only consensus from becoming a real-money experiment and reduces false promotion from tiny favorable samples.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 30 completed round trips and 14 days per strategy-chain pair, with congestion and low-liquidity periods represented; this is research evidence only, not automatic CANARY authority.
proposals.rationale: Architecture approval is not economic evidence. Promotion must require fresh runtime forensics, independently reconciled realised outcomes, adequate regime coverage, and exact-source matching.
proposals.shadow_test: Replay the lifecycle using immutable SHADOW outcomes. Permit a promotion-candidate result only if fresh evidence includes at least 30 independent completed round trips per strategy and chain, positive money-weighted user net P&L after every cost, profit factor above 1.2, and positive net results in at least three non-overlapping time/regime windows. Stop on non-positive cumulative net, missing reconciliation, any safety-gate bypass, or execution-failure cost above 20% of gross edge.

proposals.downside_risk: Reported performance will be lower and some observations will remain unresolved until receipts or rent reconciliation arrive.

evidence.detail: realised_net_base subtracts transaction gas, but strategy input remains pre-profit-share; failed or timed-out broadcasts are logged as REJECTED without reconciled gas loss.

Market-native recording accepts SUCCESS, SUCCESS_FEE_PENDING, and BROADCAST, falls back to expected net when realised net is absent, ignores profit_fee_base, and does not monetise rejected execution attempts.
Default net is gross profit minus gross loss, fees, and slippage, while execution_failures are only a count and price-impact/failed-attempt costs have no dedicated reconciliation.
Solana receipts expose network, priority, tip, platform, rent, wallet-delta, slippage, and price-impact fields suitable for complete chain-specific reconciliation.

proposals.expected_effect: Produces conservative, auditable money-weighted net results and cleanly attributes STRATEGY/MARKET loss versus EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE failure.
proposals.minimum_observation: 100% reconciliation of at least 30 completed or failed attempts per active chain, with unresolved transactions reported separately and excluded from positive realised P&L.
proposals.rationale: The objective is user NET P&L. Expected results, pending broadcasts, profit-share liabilities, failed gas/priority spend, and unresolved rent cannot be treated as realised profit.
proposals.shadow_test: Build a SHADOW ledger that joins every decision, broadcast, receipt, fee settlement, and Solana rent event. Define STRATEGY/MARKET loss as a successfully executed and reconciled position with negative user net; define EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE failure as submission, RPC, simulation, nonce, receipt, or reconciliation failure, charging any consumed gas/priority/tip. Compare old and new totals and stop if any broadcast is classified as realised before final receipt or if ledger totals do not reconcile to wallet deltas within chain-specific tolerances.
proposals.strategy: Direct Market Arbitrage and Strategy Lab accounting

proposals.downside_risk: Requires reliable point-in-time valuation data and introduces explicit handling for missing conversion evidence.

evidence.detail: Windows have no chain, quote currency, notional, capital-at-risk, or conversion fields; metrics sum raw net_profit values.
Strategy scorecards sum quote_simulated_net_base while only recording chain slugs as counts, allowing unlike base-token units to be combined.
Common bps rules are useful, but fixed 4-6 bps thresholds do not themselves establish economic adequacy under different Solana and EVM fee, latency, and failure regimes.

proposals.expected_effect: Prevents cross-chain unit mixing and reveals whether gains are concentrated in one chain, size band, or market regime.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 30 reconciled outcomes per strategy-chain pair across three non-overlapping windows, with notional and capital exposure recorded for every outcome.
proposals.rationale: SOL, ETH, BNB, and other native-token amounts are not additive. Durable performance needs per-chain cost models and a common valuation unit captured at decision and outcome time, alongside deployed capital.
proposals.shadow_test: Produce parallel per-chain and common-unit scorecards using point-in-time, timestamped conversion evidence. Calculate total user net, net/notional, net/capital-time, drawdown, and failure-cost ratio without averaging chain economics. Stop and mark the aggregate unavailable if conversion evidence is missing, stale, or inconsistent; never substitute current prices retrospectively.

proposals.downside_risk: Quotes may be sparse or expire quickly; conservative failure and latency reserves may eliminate most apparent opportunities.

evidence.detail: Solana leader events intentionally set current edge, liquidity, sellability, fees, slippage, and impact to zero and flag needs_quote_feature_adapter.
The live entry architecture estimates current round-trip deterioration, network fees, two-leg slippage reserve, and latency reserve before entry.
LIVE execution rejects routes without quoted price impact, providing a suitable fail-closed requirement for SHADOW economics.
Detailed Solana fee, priority, tip, platform, rent, wallet-delta, slippage, impact, and hop evidence is already recorded.

proposals.expected_effect: Creates falsifiable Solana evidence using its distinct priority-fee, rent, route-impact, latency, and leader-copy economics without enabling trades.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 50 eligible observations and 30 complete counterfactual round trips over 14 days, including congested and illiquid periods; no profitability or promotion conclusion from quotes alone.
proposals.rationale: The shared strategy families cannot currently be evaluated economically on Solana. Historical leader win ratios are not executable follower edge and must remain contextual only.
proposals.shadow_test: At each historical decision time, persist a non-signing entry quote, immediate sell quote, route impact, platform fee, network/priority/tip estimate, rent treatment, quote age, leader latency, and failure reserve. Track a delayed executable counterfactual and later exit outcome. Stop the hypothesis if cumulative net after all costs is non-positive, more than 10% of required fields are missing, quote-to-execution deterioration consumes the edge, or sellability cannot be demonstrated.

proposals.downside_risk: Lower participation and longer evidence collection during low-edge markets.

evidence.detail: Every strategy requires positive current net edge plus freshness, liquidity, and sellability checks; forecast signals cannot replace current executable edge.
EVM candidates require positive current quoted edge and a 2x-size impact check, while wallet-specific simulation remains mandatory before signing.
No eligible opportunity leads to continued scanning rather than manufacturing a trade.

proposals.expected_effect: Avoids structurally negative trades and preserves chain-specific execution protections.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 100 rejected and 30 eligible observations per chain across multiple volatility and congestion regimes.
proposals.rationale: Abstention is economically correct when executable edge is absent. These protections align with net-P&L optimization and must not be weakened to increase win count or activity.
proposals.shadow_test: Continue logging every rejected setup with its cost-adjusted edge and later counterfactual outcome. Fail the gate hypothesis only if a preregistered, sufficiently large out-of-sample set shows rejected opportunities would have produced positive user net after identical costs without increasing tail loss or execution failure.

rejected_ideas.idea: Promote any strategy based on this cycle's architecture review.
rejected_ideas.reason: Fresh runtime forensics are unavailable, so profitability, CANARY readiness, and LIVE readiness are unproven.

rejected_ideas.idea: Increase trade frequency or relax minimum edge to improve win count.
rejected_ideas.reason: Win count is not the objective and can destroy user net P&L after costs; no trade is preferable to non-positive executable edge.

rejected_ideas.idea: Mix raw SOL, ETH, BNB, or other native-token profits into one portfolio total.
rejected_ideas.reason: Unlike units are not additive and can produce a false cross-chain profitability conclusion.

rejected_ideas.idea: Treat quotes, simulations, broadcasts, pending fee settlements, or historical leader success as realised profit.
rejected_ideas.reason: They do not establish final wallet-delta P&L after all costs and failures.

rejected_ideas.idea: Reduce simulation, sellability, liquidity, reserve, stop-loss, circuit-breaker, nonce, signing, or reconciliation safeguards to lower costs.
rejected_ideas.reason: Such changes would increase tail and execution risk and violate the required protection floor.

summary: Architecture-only review completed. The repository correctly prefers abstention and contains substantial EVM and Solana execution protections, but no current runtime evidence supports profitability or CANARY/LIVE readiness. Research accounting can overstate durable user net P&L by omitting profit-share settlement and failed-transaction costs, and generic scorecards lack safe cross-chain money weighting. Strategy/market losses and execution/infrastructure failures are counted separately in places, but their monetary costs are not consistently reconciled. Keep all strategies SHADOW until chain-specific, out-of-sample realised evidence proves positive executable net P&L.
